steps.assertion: No session filter is selected by default
steps.text: Open **Platform Billing > Billing Sessions**. The list shows every month, closed ones included, so you can see what was done before.

steps.assertion: Create a monthly platform billing session
The historical French session name is suggested
steps.text: Pick the **billing period**: the first day of the month you are closing. Odoo names the session after the month, in French as the history always has, and proposes the month-end as invoice date.
Under **Payouts**, choose **Add a line** for each platform that reported a payout this month.
Pick the platform, the payout date and the platform's own reference, then enter the **net amount** the platform reported. The gross revenue and the commission are derived from the platform's rate.

steps.assertion: Save through the real form and run the accounting checks
steps.text: Choose **Check**. The session is saved and the accounting checks run: platforms, journals, products and amounts must all be in place before anything is generated.

steps.assertion: Generate customer invoice and commission bill drafts
steps.text: Choose **Generate drafts**: one customer invoice for the revenue and one bill for the commission, per payout, in draft.

steps.assertion: Incomplete active-platform coverage is clearly identified
steps.text: When an active platform has no payout this month, Odoo says which one before posting. This is the moment to add a forgotten line.

steps.assertion: Confirm the deliberate monthly coverage exception
steps.text: Confirm when the gap is deliberate, for example a platform that pays quarterly.

steps.assertion: The delayed payout stays posted and open
steps.text: The session is **Posted**. A payout whose money has not arrived stays open; the invoice is posted and waits for the bank.

steps.assertion: Bank reconciliation remains available for the later receipt
steps.text: **Reconcile bank** stays available: come back when the receipt shows on the bank statement.

title: Create and post a monthly platform billing session
